name: Fencing
tagline: Timber, Colorbond, pool fencing, gates, repairs

catalog.label: Glass pool fencing, per linear metre

extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional fencing company. Ask about the fence type, length, height, and purpose (boundary, pool, security). Ask about access, slope, and whether old fencing needs removal. Ask about pool compliance if relevant. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed on site. Do not promise a specific compliance outcome that is not in the reference answers.

kb.a: Our licence number is [your licence number], and our insurer is [insurer name]. Certificates are available on request before any work starts.
{price_note} Fencing is priced per linear metre, including materials and installation. Send us the length and fence type for an estimate.
Yes, we install pool fencing. We check your pool layout and gate positions before we quote, so you know what the fence needs.
Yes, we supply and install Colorbond fencing. Tell us the colour and height you want, and we will confirm the options when we quote.
Yes, we install timber paling and picket fencing. Timber can be stained or left natural, and we can talk through the options when we quote.
Yes, we install frameless and semi-frameless glass fencing. Glass pool fencing is quoted per linear metre, with the fittings listed in your quote.
Yes, we install aluminium fencing and matching gates. We can show you the styles available when we visit.
Yes, we repair storm damage, broken palings, and leaning posts. Tell us what happened, and we will advise whether a repair or a replacement makes more sense.
Yes, we remove and dispose of old fencing. We confirm what is included, such as posts and concrete, in your quote.
Yes, we install driveway and pedestrian gates. Gate hardware and latches are listed separately in your quote.
Yes, we install automatic gate systems. We confirm the power supply and motor type on a site visit before we quote.
Yes, we build timber, concrete, and block retaining walls. We check the site and soil on a visit before we quote.

kb.q: Do I need a permit for a fence?
kb.a: Some fences and retaining walls need approval from your council. We can advise what may apply to your property, but please confirm with your council.
Most residential fences take [number] days, depending on length and access. We confirm the timing when we book.
Yes, we service commercial properties. Commercial work is quoted separately after a site visit.
{warranty_note} Ask us to explain what is covered before the job starts.
We service [service area] and nearby suburbs. Tell us your suburb when you book, and we will confirm whether we cover it.

kb.q: Do I need to be home for the fence work?
kb.a: It helps for the quote, but it is not needed for the work. We need access to the site on the day, so tell us about gates and keys.
Yes, we remove vegetation and old fence materials. Disposal costs are shown in your quote.
We try to match existing styles and colours. Some products may be discontinued, so we check availability during the visit.

automation_rules.description: Remind owner 30 days before insurance expires

compliance.guidance: Check whether a building permit, registration or domestic building insurance applies to the work before you quote. Keep certificates of currency for public liability and any required insurance. Your state regulator sets the rules.
items: Registration or licence number on quotes where required
Permit records kept against the project
